title: Completeness gap: conformance/parse/sum.facts.json and recover_per_item.* not yet authored (parser oracle incomplete)

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Audit of the four authored oracle fixtures (binary_search.addresses.json, sum.addresses.json, address/README.md, parse/binary_search.facts.json) found NO DIVERGENCE — all faithfully transcribe the verbatim corpus + thermite-design.md §4.1/§4.3/Appendix A + semantic-addressing.md AC-1/AC-2. Gap: the route conformance_ops=[binary_search, sum, recover_per_item] for thermite-syntax/src/parse implies sum.facts.json and recover_per_item.{facts,addresses}.json are expected, but only binary_search.facts.json exists. recover_per_item.th corpus also absent. Per-item recovery (design §4.3 'recovery is per-item by construction') has no oracle fixture yet. Non-blocking; the four present fixtures are clean.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Completeness gap filled: authored conformance/parse/sum.facts.json, conformance/parse/recover_per_item.th + .facts.json, conformance/parse/README.md (all hand-derived from the design/corpus per R-CHAR-3). acto-critic re-audited the new set: NO DIVERGENCE FOUND (spec_sum no-contract-clauses + sum ens_count=2 verified; missing-ens=parse-error confirmed against §4.1 + surface-grammar.md/parser.md, so the per-item recovery fixture is a valid oracle). The full parser+address oracle is now in place and critic-verified.
